propositions: Root disk fills to 92-96% during autodeploy build bursts and stays pinned because prune_docker_caches() is only called on deploy and backoff paths, not on quiescent no-op ticks.

The autodeploy no-op early exit (line 228) must trigger a throttled, pressure-aware docker prune when root disk usage exceeds DISK_PRESSURE_PCT (default 80%) to prevent sustained disk pressure between deploys.

prune_docker_caches() is currently defined after line 228 (around line 245), making it uncallable from the no-op exit; it must be relocated into the helper block (~line 150) to precede all call sites.
The pressure-triggered prune must be throttled to a minimum interval (default 600s) via a persisted timestamp file to avoid per-tick churn and excess docker invocations.
A failure in prune_docker_caches() on the no-op pressure path must not alter the script's exit code (remains 0) and must emit a countable AUTODEPLOY_DISK_PRESSURE marker.
